results_section.claim: 1. Semantic patterns show 12.56 percentage point separation (-6.05% vs +6.51%), structural patterns show 11.48 point separation (-17.78% vs -6.30%).
results_section.explanation: Analysis stage: The 12.56 pp separation matches degradation_metrics.json (mixed: -6.0506..%, control: +6.507..%), and 11.48 pp from sentence length changes.
